stage_a.backbones: frozen V3F and V3AG release assets
losses: source-balanced BCE with training-only positive weight clipped to [1, 10]
source-balanced focal loss, gamma 2, training-only prevalence alpha
stage_a.threshold_calibration: separate frozen calibration partition; holdout labels never used for threshold selection
stage_a.compare_to: immutable published weights on the same raw eligible records and endpoint masks

source_holdouts.primary_rhythm: train Chapman plus CPSC after excluding every record in the pinned public V4.5 P6/P8 evaluation manifests and exact waveform duplicates; calibrate and early-stop on separate Chapman partitions; evaluate remaining Georgia source records; historical backbone exposure remains unknown
source_holdouts.complementary_loso: train Chapman plus eligible Georgia records after excluding all known public V4.5 P6/P8 evaluation records and exact waveform duplicates; evaluate CPSC; development-domain sensitivity only
source_holdouts.pathology: PTB-XL folds 1-7 train, fold 8 early stopping, patient-hash split of fold 9 for calibration/internal evaluation; fold 10 excluded

stage_b.gate: consider only after Stage-A diagnostics; freeze a separate protocol and assess catastrophic-forgetting risk before unfreezing any backbone block

optuna.reason: bounded predeclared Stage-A comparison; source holdouts must not become search/tuning sets

privacy.new_checkpoints: private CEDIA storage until separate release/privacy review
privacy.public_outputs: sanitized aggregates, code, configs, hashes of model artifacts only
